# Volume 3 timeline

## Chapter I The Shadow of Change

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about growing up and upcoming changes as they rest in the orchard. After getting a letter from [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the bridge, but she gets flustered and cuts the moment short when he touches her hand. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) and talks with him before spending a quiet moment dreaming by the brook.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

## Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cheer her up after her spirits are dampened by the townspeople's doubts about her going to college. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) watch them walk off from the window, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stroll through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) and discover a wild apple tree.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P7](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0007), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P18](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0018), [v3 ch.Autumn P29](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0029)_

## Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) amidst tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her to their new boardinghouse while chatting gaily to lift her homesick spirits.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

## Chapter IV April’s Lady

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go to register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feel overwhelmed and insignificant. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Old St. John's Cemetery, where she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eagerly strikes up a conversation and introduces herself.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P5](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0005), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats lightly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors, her hesitations about [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), and her fear of marriage before they explore an old graveyard together. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pauses at the grave of an eighteen-year-old midshipman and leaves a small cluster of pansies on it. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Philippa's charming, innocent nature compared to [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P67](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0067), [v3 ch.Lady P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

## Chapter V Letters from Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their freshman class wins the annual Arts Rush under [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly adopts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them into Redmond's active social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a bundle of letters from home—including updates from [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md)—which helps connect her old life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

## Chapter VI In the Park

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk in the park together and admire the autumn foliage and harbour views. On their return route along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) shows them a charming, old-fashioned little house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032), [v3 ch.Park P40](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0040)_

## Chapter VII Home Again

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays and is greeted warmly by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Before going to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he was tempted to say a bad word, and she gently helps him process it so he can say his prayers.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034), [v3 ch.Again P46](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0046)_

## Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md). Shocked and amused by the unromantic nature of a proposal by proxy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses the offer, prompting [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) to respond coldly.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 ch.Proposal P28](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0028)_

## Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Patty’s Place, [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — During her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects a proposal from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), causing tension between them. Later, [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) suggesting they rent a house together for the next school year with Stella's [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as housekeeper. Excited by the idea, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go house-hunting around [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) and discover that Patty's Place is available to rent.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_

## Chapter X Patty’s Place

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) Spofford for the upcoming school year. Later, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits them and excitedly asks to join their housekeeping arrangement, agreeing to their conditions regarding chores, plain living, and set caller hours.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

## Chapter XI The Round of Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill with consumption. On their way to visit Ruby, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stop at the Wrights' house, where [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) makes several unpleasant comments, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reveals to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) her plans to write a short story. They then visit the Gillis household, finding a lively crowd and Ruby stubbornly insisting she is perfectly healthy despite her failing condition.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)_

## Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a story, titled Averil's Atonement, and shares it with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) for feedback. After revising the story based on Mr. Harrison's critiques, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) submits it to magazines, but it is repeatedly rejected. Discouraged by the rejections, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to give up her literary ambitions despite Mr. Harrison's advice to keep writing.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P28](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0028), [v3 ch.Atonement” P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041), [v3 ch.Atonement” P67](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0067), [v3 ch.Atonement” P73](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0073)_

## Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md)** — Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) and go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons) instead. After lying to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to cover up his misdeeds, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) suffers from a guilty conscience and late that night confesses everything to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who forgives him and instructs him to pray for forgiveness.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v3 ch.Transgressors P56](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0056), [v3 ch.Transgressors P94](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0094)_

## Chapter XIV The Summons

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers comfort, but Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 ch.Summons P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)_

## Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)** — After Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) hints at a story competition, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reveals to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she secretly modified and submitted Anne's story 'Averil's Atonement' to a baking powder advertisement contest. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is devastated by the commercial degradation of her work, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to reassure her about the practical aspect of winning the prize money.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P4](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0004), [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

## Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [William Blair](../character/william-blair.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) settles into Patty's Place with her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). [The Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly establishes dominance over [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), while [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) engage in repeated battles before eventually becoming close friends. The household chats comfortably about house duties and Aunt Jamesina's humorous views on cats and life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

## Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) arrives with butter and chats with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about rising prices and simple living. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), which recounts humorously misspelled updates about his school, household misadventures, and curious questions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006), [v3 ch.Davy P21](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0021)_

## Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — During a stormy holiday break at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Davy's lively chatter. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail, bringing letters from college friends and news that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a thousand dollars.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P23](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0023), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

## Chapter XIX An Interlude

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) chat in the living room on Anne's twentieth birthday. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) comes downstairs in her party dress to admire herself in the mirror and join the conversation about her various suitors and future prospects before leaving for a dance. Afterwards, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) briefly discuss Phil's quirky disposition.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Interlude P36](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0036)_

## Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat inside Patty's Place before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps outside into the orchard. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) heartbroken and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upset over the loss of their friendship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P36](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0036)_

## Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — During her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace and meets the woman currently living there. The woman allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to explore the house, including the room where she was born, and hands over a small packet of old letters written by Anne's parents. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits her parents' grave and reads the letters, feeling for the first time that she truly knows them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P22](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0022)_

## Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has brightened her life when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unexpectedly arrives home a day early from college. The two reminisce and discuss [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), before [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts in and excitedly catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up on his latest antics.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gables P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003), [v3 ch.Gables P4](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0004), [v3 ch.Gables P12](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0012), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)_

## Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends part of her summer vacation in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) visiting with friends and family, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). While enjoying her time, she reflects on growing older and admits to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) that she refused Gilbert's proposal because she only sees him as a friend.

## Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) writes a letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) describing her summer stay at a boardinghouse. She recounts meeting a homely divinity student named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), whose impressive sermon leaves her deeply moved and questioning her own frivolous nature. In a postscript, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) admits to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she fears she has fallen in love with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

## Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) before going for a walk in the park to clear her head. During a sudden downpour, her umbrella breaks and she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares his umbrella with her. After walking her home, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a box of roses, prompting teaseful remarks from [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wonders if she has met her ideal prince.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md)** — While dressing for a reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquiets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) arrives to escort [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the event, where she spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Christine across the room and compares herself to her.

Later, while out walking, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she has accepted Jonas's marriage proposal. As they discuss love and marriage, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her feelings for [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling sad about how growing up changes relationships and reflecting on her feelings regarding [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md).

## Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, where they converse about their summer plans and changing lives.

During the drive to Janet's home, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with stories about her recent marriage and her romantic decisions.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describing her new boarding place at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and her pleasant landlady, Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes her cozy room, the quirky parlour, and an awkward visit from a local boy named [Sam](../character/sam.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also hints at an elderly love affair happening nearby that she is observing from afar.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Janet](../character/janet.md) to a prayer meeting in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where she meets [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), Janet's quiet admirer. The next day, John invites them both to his house for tea so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can meet his elderly mother. During the visit, Mrs. Douglas treats [Janet](../character/janet.md) politely while making light comments about her impending death and John's eventual marriage, leaving John looking visibly tortured.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

## Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md)** — [Janet](../character/janet.md) tearfully confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) has been visiting her for twenty years without proposing. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to take a firm stand, [Janet](../character/janet.md) sharply rejects John's escort after prayer-meeting, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) immediately regrets her advice upon seeing John's heartbreak and rushes to reconcile them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P17](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0017), [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 ch.Coming” P27](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0027)_

## Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — During her time in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). After John Douglas's mother passes away, [Alec](../character/alec.md) fetches [Janet](../character/janet.md), and John soon arrives to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his mother forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

Later, while studying during a rainy evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) reminisce over old [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) manuscripts, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to read a sketch she wrote years before and make a sudden decision.

## Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to learn from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her deep love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and fearing for his life. At dawn, she speaks with [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), who tells her that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) passed the crisis and will recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)_

## Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ask her on a walk, but after she declines due to a wedding, they arrange to meet the following afternoon. The next day, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) confesses his love and proposes. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily accepts, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) explains that his past actions were misunderstood while they look forward to their future together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Time P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015), [v3 ch.Time P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022), [v3 ch.Time P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 ch.Time P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025)_
